statement: A boundary trial draws from fitted pi(.|A),chooses an actual dominating outgoing proposal,and returns zero for null/rejected/stays-in-A events. Otherwise it simulates until return or an independent kill. Uniformized rational categories implement r_s=s+R*theta with no real exponential oracle;all interior nulls count. Each excursion has mean duration<=1/s and expected proposal count Lambda/s plus initialization/boundary calls. Hard runtime caps require an extra tail allowance. A positive trial success floor is needed for multiplicative estimation;the subtraction in R_s remains separately guarded. Small killed-Poisson solves win on the supplied small systems,and flux-only omission of return information can be badly wrong.
